flows.notes: C3 save-selector reconciliation: crew-roster, data-flow, edit-recovery, library-open and small-craft-armor save through the customizer. The saved-custom combat specs consume server-saved designs. Canonical/local-draft loading is in unit-open. Shared unit services include critical-slot residual and notice effects; those changes must also select editor-commit in step 5.
C3 import row includes shared import components, unit-loader normalization and the MTF vocabulary.

C3 retains customizer.spec and exotic-mech in the PR tier; layout-workbench is nightly-only by design. criticalSlot*.ts also covers the forthcoming criticalSlotNoticeEffects.ts without introducing a glob that matches nothing today. Critical-slot residual/notice changes select both editor-commit and unit-save-load in step 5. Fail-open coverage for shared customizer/store/unit-service changes belongs to that later selection step.

C3 print row includes the existing fixed PR record-sheet rendering spec and shared construction/type inputs. The draft recordSheet*/** directory glob matched nothing; the live RecordSheet component glob covers family previews.

C4 day advancement uses two files, not a nonexistent dayAdvancement directory. Includes shared campaign UI and save boundaries; crash-window-flush stays mapped. The pending save-loss sweep is owned by campaign-persistence, whose paths also overlap this save boundary.
C4 owns this row jointly with C3. These two specs are the current refit drivers. check3-refit-roundtrip is not a repository E2E spec yet.
C4 UI intervention/command flows include InteractiveSession and the privacy approval pack. The standalone simulation runner is outside this UI path. ux-deep-play-audit stays mapped.

C4 full 30-spec set stays nightly by default; server.js or src/lib/multiplayer/server/** changes are the narrow exception that must select the full set once step 5 is enabled. No generic persistence trigger.

These original load-side candidates open canonical units or local drafts, rather than server-saved units: Add Unit/blank draft, family skeletons, header actions, load cancellation, loadout actions and deep-link draft recovery. Split from unit-save-load after reading each spec.
C4 five-spec PR-tier subset for all shared multiplayer/P2P/session boundaries. The server-only trigger on multiplayer-session selects the full set as well in step 5.
C4 amendment after the pack-consumer regression: all eight parity specs and the manifest guard consume this shared pack contract.

pendingSpecs.reason: Written in C4 campaign save-loss fix PR 1/2; not yet on main.

flows.notes: C4 unload/adoption sweep must run nightly and for changes to any of these save/service-worker boundaries once selection is enabled, rather than in every PR gate. The guard requires promotion from pendingSpecs to specs when C4 adds the file. Old-tab/unvisited-route checks from #3315 are unit tests in src/hooks/__tests__, not E2E specs.
